text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Human experience of overdose with OLYSIO is limited. There is no specific antidote for overdose with OLYSIO. In the event of an overdose, the patient's clinical status should be observed and the usual supportive measures employed. Simeprevir is highly protein-bound; therefore, dialysis is unlikely to result in significant removal of simeprevir [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3) ] .
